item.title: US strikes against Iran-backed militias in Iraq reportedly continue as Baghdad warns of 'right to respond'
item.summary: Iraq's Prime Minister al-Sudani threatened to confront and respond to U.S. airstrikes on PMF headquarters, calling the attacks violations of Iraqi sovereignty.

item.title: New York Times columnist tells liberal readers Trump's war with Iran is 'going better than you think'
item.summary: New York Times columnist Bret Stephens praised President Donald Trump's successes in his war against Iran, telling the paper's liberal readers it's "going better than you think."

item.title: Khanna urges King Charles to meet Epstein victims during Capitol visit
item.summary: Rep. Ro Khanna, D-Calif., tells Fox News he wants King Charles to meet with Epstein victims and others when he comes to Capitol Hill next month to deliver a speech before a Joint Meeting of Congress.

item.title: Left-wing influencer downplays Cuba blackouts, worsening shortages: ‘People are partying’
item.summary: Progressive streamer Hasan Piker is contending that Cubans are partying despite rolling blackouts, downplaying the energy crisis during his recent trip to the communist island.

item.title: Illinois Gov Pritzker admits 'real failures' as slain Chicago student's hometown pays tribute in lights
item.summary: Illinois Gov. JB Pritzker admits "real failures" in immigration after Sheridan Gorman's alleged murder by an illegal immigrant released under Biden.

item.title: Bipartisan Senate bill to cap insulin for Americans at $35 has new momentum
item.summary: Senators are pushing the bipartisan INSULIN Act of 2026, which would cap insulin costs at $35 a month for insured and uninsured Americans starting 2027.

item.title: Former Olympic star's son dies after getting caught up in avalanche
item.summary: Former Canadian Olympic star John Smart announced on Monday that his son, Kai, died after suffering injuries in an avalanche while skiing in Japan.

item.summary: Former Vice President Kamala Harris' Headquarters accuses Jake Tapper of cosplaying Gen Z content creators, saying a podcast mic won't make CNN relevant again.

item.title: Democrats rip Trump’s ICE airport move as shutdown nears 40 days: ‘no reason’
item.summary: Democrats blasted Trump's decision to deploy ICE to airports on Monday as the partial government shutdown nears 40 days and TSA agents struggle without paychecks.

item.title: LA model and influencer charged with using dating apps to burglarize homes of elderly, wealthy victims
item.summary: LA model Adva Lavie, also known as Mia Ventura, allegedly used dating apps to burglarize elderly victims, now facing six felony counts including burglary.
